recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-shot of a female vocalist performing with a microphone against a dark, textured background, featuring bold, lime-green block typography with a heavy 3D drop shadow at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the lime-green subject/text and the deep black background
Dynamic diagonal pose of the performer creating energy
Textual weight at the top balancing the visual weight of the performer below
Grainy, film-like texture across the entire composition
coreInvariants: Lime green as the primary accent color
Heavy, sans-serif display type with dimensional depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central mid-shot, performer occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The performer's face and the microphone at the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright green title at the top, down the performer's arm to the microphone, and across the lime-green dress.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black space surrounding the head and shoulders to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the green against a low-value, desaturated background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to lime green, black, and muted skin tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers and letters share the same cap height and weight

treatment.shadow: deep 3D drop shadow in dark teal or black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy weight for impact, secondary metadata in small, wide sans-serif.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, high-contrast photograph of a soul singer in a lime green striped dress performing on a dark stage, captured on 35mm film.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, lime-green sans-serif text at the top with a heavy 3D drop shadow, ensuring tight kerning.

verificationChecks: Is the green vibrant and lime-toned?
Does the text have a visible 3D depth?
Is the background sufficiently dark and textured?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D shadow depth on text
Ensure subject is centered and dynamic
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast performer photography + Lime green bold sans-serif + 3D block shadow = 1960s Soul Aesthetic.
